verdict.rationale: DBOS supports automatic triggering of workflows via cron-style schedules (dbos-docs-7) and via message-based signals with DBOS.send/recv (dbos-docs-8, dbos-docs-27, dbos-docs-28), which can act as event-driven triggers for actions, and queues can auto-start workflows on enqueue (dbos-docs-6). However, there's no evidence of a declarative 'rules' definition mechanism (conditional logic tied to arbitrary events like webhooks or external event buses) — it's closer to workflow scheduling/messaging than a rules engine. Missing for 10: explicit rule/condition definition syntax, generic external event source integration, and documented event-trigger examples beyond cron/messaging.
